verdict.rationale: Pomelo ships its own natural-language layer: an AI assistant for API questions and an official MCP server whose tools find endpoints from Spanish or English queries and generate request code. It is marketed as connecting to the APIs 'using natural language.' However, the documented tools only cover discovery and code generation, not running card, user or transaction operations directly from natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documented natural-language execution of product operations (e.g., issuing cards, blocking merchants), any action-taking MCP tools, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
